chunks: From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from a man, from Abu al-Hasan al-Madi (peace be upon him), who said:
I asked him: For how many years and months is the prayer offered over the infant? He said: 'Prayer is offered over him in all cases, unless it is omitted due to incomplete [age/period].'

key_terms.عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ: in all cases / under all circumstances

ai.seo_question: When is the funeral prayer offered over a deceased infant according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Rida (AS) clarifies that the funeral prayer is obligatory for infants regardless of age, establishing a general rule of inclusivity in ritual purification. The exception 'unless it falls short of completeness' is interpreted by Shia jurists as referring to premature birth where the infant is not considered fully formed or viable, distinguishing it from standard infant death. This ruling underscores the spiritual dignity of even the youngest members of the community within Shia fiqh.
